messages.content: I'm interested in environmental science. Does Ramapo have a related major or minor, and are there student organizations where I could meet people with that interest?

expected_behaviors: Search academic programs and student organizations independently.
Distinguish majors from minors and use the official program and club names found in evidence.

result.answer:
Yes. Ramapo has an Environmental Science BS major and an Environmental Science minor, both in the School of Theoretical and Applied Science. [Ramapo Programs](https://www.ramapo.edu/majors-minors/environmental-science/)

A closely related option also appears in the program listings: an Environmental Studies minor in the School of Social Science and Human Services. [Ramapo Programs](https://www.ramapo.edu/majors-minors/environmental-studies/)

I could verify the academic programs, but I wasn’t able to retrieve confirmed organization records in this turn to reliably name student groups and describe their focus. If you want, I can do a targeted club search next for sustainability, conservation, climate, gardening, or outdoor/nature groups.

fields.description: The minor provides students with a firm grounding in physical and historical geology. Students will gain experience in geological cartographic techniques, be able to identify the major minerals and rocks (in the laboratory and the field), and gain practice in geological field techniques. result.answer:
